test_title: SSC Selection Post HSC Level Official Paper (Held on: 11 Feb 2022 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Study the given bar graph and answer the question that follows.

The bar graph shows the number of students enrolled in Institutes A and B during 5 years (2014 to 2018).

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/a7c0d5db4c31577ec3014a9d9bbd12073cee7f7d759f02ecb83340382fd594ca.png] 

If the students of Institute A for each year are represented on a pie chart, then the angle corresponding to year 2016 will be:
solution:
**Calculation:**

Total number of students of Institute A for 5 years = 160 + 280 + 300 + 250 + 260

⇒ 1250

Number of students of Institute A in the year 2016 = 300

Required angle = (300/1250) × 360°

⇒ 86.4°

**∴ Required answer is 86.4°**
